## The ONLY Candidate Endorsed by the Democratic Party
# Aisha fights for you!
Tackling real issues. Delivering real results.
DONATE
## “…known for her no-nonsense style of lawmaking and willingness to ruffle feathers.”
— POLITICO
## Putting You First.
The status quo is afraid because I work for you—not billion-dollar corporations.
I’ve taken on powerful interest groups to fight for affordable housing, expand homeownership, and improve living conditions. When affordability is on the line, I don’t back down.
I’ve fought for good jobs, career training for all ages, and real investment in the small businesses that keep our communities strong.
In tough times, I’ve protected funding for food, healthcare, and public education — because dignity and opportunity shouldn’t be out of reach.
I’ve partnered with law enforcement to make public safety a priority and led efforts to build a cleaner, healthier environment for the next generation.
This fight is bigger than me—and long overdue. I’m running to keep fighting for the Bay Area we all deserve, and I can’t do it without you.
-Dr. Aisha Wahab
